_form: जाति प्रमाण पत्र हेतु आवेदन पत्र (अनुसूचित जाति/अनुसूचित जन जाति) — परिशिष्ट-अ, Rajasthan eMitra
_notes: Row indices are extract-form-boxes.py's own ordering. Cell counts are
pinned so a re-issued form fails the build rather than shifting a
citizen's Aadhaar one column.
This form must be read with ink=rects and widest=500, both pinned below.
It was made in Word and draws boxes two ways at once: every field is its
own closed rectangle, and the Aadhaar/Bhamashah table at the top is a
Word table whose borders are 0.5pt filled rectangles. The default parse
finds four cells on the whole page. The 481pt 'निवासी' box on the
affidavit page needs the wider cap or it is dropped in silence.
There are three of these forms, one per category, and this is the SC/ST
one. The blank doc/build-log/10 collected is the सामान्य वर्ग (General)
form, which this template never wants — caste-certificate.json offers SC,
ST and OBC only. The OBC/SBC form is a separate blank of its own.
The form's tick habit is the OPPOSITE of PMUY's: here the box comes
BEFORE its printed word (box, then पुरुष). Confirmed by eye on the
gender/marital row and both Yes/No declarations.
Item 7's जाति box is PRE-PRINTED 'अनुसूचित जाति/जन जाति' — it is the
form telling you which category it is for, not a box to fill. Named here
so the checker accounts for it, never written to. Item 8's जाति is the
father's and is genuinely blank.
The form asks religion, caste and sub-caste TWICE — item 7 for the
applicant, item 8 for the father — and item 9 asks which caste and
religion the applicant has recorded in education and business records.
dob and declarationDate are not boxes. Each is a box with a printed
____/____/______ inside it, and writing a date straight in would
overstrike the slashes — the LPG dob bug again. They are declared under
`guides` instead: each run of underscores becomes one cell and the slot's
yBot is the baseline they sit on, so day, month and year go on their own
runs. The runs are 5, 6 and 8 underscores wide. A third group of three
runs exists at baseline 747.84, inside the patwari's block — not ours.
Not mapped, deliberately, the same call as PMUY page 2: section 2 (हल्का
पटवार जाँच रिपोर्ट, page 1 rows 21-24) belongs to the patwari, and page 2
(section 3, प्रमाण-पत्र) is two witness attestations to be signed by a
responsible person. Page 3 (section 5, शपथ-पत्र) IS the citizen's and is
mapped. Numbering to be aware of: no form in this series has a section 4,
and the General-category blank skips item 8 entirely. This one does not.
The affidavit repeats name, father's name, residence, village, tehsil,
district and caste, so those come from the same answers as page 1.
